prompt: Zip two lists together. Complete the interleave method so it returns a new list alternating elements from a and b, appending whatever is left of the longer list, without modifying either input.
explanation: A single index loop up to the size of the longer list drives the merge; at each step the element from a is added if a still has one, then the element from b. The two independent if checks mean the loop keeps appending from whichever list is longer after the shorter one runs out. Building into a freshly created ArrayList leaves both inputs untouched.
hints: Loop i from 0 up to Math.max(a.size(), b.size()).
Inside the loop use two separate if statements: add a.get(i) when i < a.size(), then add b.get(i) when i < b.size().
Add everything to a brand-new ArrayList and return it -- never call add or remove on a or b.
